en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large military parade ground flanked by two long, four‑storey barracks buildings with hipped roofs and many windows. On the open square, soldiers are standing in formation, drilling, or marching, with officers observing. Training equipment and simple wooden structures are visible around the edges. A red handwritten number "26731" appears at the top right, and a printed caption along the bottom identifies the location as an infantry regiment barracks in Grimma.
